user.title: Connect TapHome core
user.description: Expose your devices in the TapHome app (Settings → Expose devices → TapHome API) and enter the token below. A local connection is recommended: only enable "Use TapHome cloud" if you can't reach the core directly on your network — the cloud updates less often (about every 20 seconds) and depends on TapHome's servers being reachable. Find your core's IP address in the TapHome app under "My location".

data.use_description_as_entity_id: Use TapHome descriptions as entity IDs
data.use_description_as_name: Use TapHome descriptions as entity names

data_description.token: Authorization token shown at the top of the TapHome API screen.
data_description.use_cloud: Connect through the TapHome cloud instead of your local network. Only recommended when the core is not reachable locally — the cloud is slower and requires an internet connection. The IP address is ignored when enabled.
data_description.ip: IP address of your TapHome core on your local network, e.g. 192.168.1.3. Find it in the TapHome app under My location. Recommended over the cloud for a faster, more reliable connection.
data_description.webhook_id: Recommended: lets the core push updates instantly instead of Home Assistant polling every 2 seconds. Enter any name, e.g. taphome_primary, then in the TapHome app on the Expose devices screen enable Webhook and set the Webhook URL to e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123/api/webhook/taphome_primary — replace homeassistant.local with your own Home Assistant address and taphome_primary with the name you entered above.

Find your core's IP address in the TapHome app under "My location".
